title: Repeat Prescription
content: Visited reception to ask about repeat prescription to treat back pain/inflammation for tablets last prescribed Nov 2000. Request taken for referal to GP and duly authorised. Appreciated acceptance of request without need to book appointment to check/discuss etc.  Thanks to receptionist/GP.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
